value.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Cursed by Light - Special finale with the gathering of the deadly sinners
value.synopsis: "You'll be missing out if you don't watch "The Seven Deadly Sins: Cursed by Light" just before it's released! The final special where the deadly sinners gather together " The hero fantasy "The Seven Deadly Sins" finally concluded last week with "Judgment of Fury". While the excitement is still high, a story that has never been told before is coming to the movie version! Now that it's just before the release, to enjoy the content even more. It's a special program that fans must see.
